author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಕಳಂಕ ಚಾರಿತ್ರ್ಯ ಸರ್ವರನು ಸೆಳೆಯುವುದು
ಸಕಲರನು ಜೊತೆಗೊಯ್ಯೆ ಸಿದ್ಧ ಅಸ್ತ್ರವದು
ಮುಕುರದಂತಿರೆ ನಿನ್ನ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯು ಮನಸಂತೆ
ವಿಕಸನಕೆ ದಾರಿಯದೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Spotless character draws everyone to you;
it is a ready weapon for carrying all people along;
when your words and deeds mirror your mind,
that is the road to growth, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Unblemished character wins people over and brings them with us. When speech and action reflect what is truly in the heart, we grow.
